functionalRequirement: A surface app page shall provide a customer with all customer system functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide access to 100% of the customer system functionality through the surface app page.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the surface app page to offer all customer system functionality, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that all customer system functionality is correctly implemented and accessible through the surface app page for 99.9% of valid user interactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for correct and precise implementation of customer system functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load the surface app page with all customer system functionality in less than 2 seconds for up to 500 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time access to customer system functionality, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The system must clearly label and organize all customer system functionality on the surface app page, with an intuitive layout that allows users to easily recognize and access the functionality they need.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the surface app page to provide an intuitive and recognizable layout for customer system functionality, supporting user engagement and ease of use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must be able to recover from failures and exceptions related to customer system functionality on the surface app page, with automatic retry mechanisms for 90% of potential failure scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to customer system functionality, necessitating robust fault tolerance and recovery mechanisms.

functionalRequirement: System shall display information and settings related to the required setting based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Appropriateness: The system must display relevant and accurate information and settings related to the required setting, based on 100% of valid user input scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to provide appropriate and relevant information and settings, necessitating careful consideration of user input and context.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 20 MB of memory to process and display information and settings related to the required setting, for a single user request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple user inputs and settings.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide clear and concise labels, tooltips, and documentation for information and settings related to the required setting, allowing users to learn and understand the functionality within 5 minutes of initial interaction.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to support user learning and understanding, necessitating clear and intuitive documentation and feedback mechanisms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that user input related to the required setting is validated and sanitized to prevent SQL injection or cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks, for 100% of potential input scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input and settings, which are potential attack vectors requiring robust security measures to protect data integrity.

functionalRequirement: If the validation fails, system shall prompt "Wrong OTP".

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must correctly validate user input and prompt "Wrong OTP" for 100% of invalid OTP scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to correctly validate user input and provide accurate feedback, necessitating precise implementation of validation logic.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide clear and concise error messages, including "Wrong OTP", with suggestions for correction or recovery, for 90% of potential error scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user validation and error handling, requiring robust mechanisms to support user recovery and error prevention.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must implement rate limiting and IP blocking to prevent brute-force attacks on OTP validation, with a maximum of 5 attempts per minute from a single IP address.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive user authentication, requiring robust security measures to prevent unauthorized access and protect user data.

functionalRequirement: Information on remaining job posting time and CV access shall be reportable

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide accurate and up-to-date information on remaining job posting time and CV access, for 100% of reportable scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to provide complete and accurate information, necessitating careful consideration of data sources and update mechanisms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate reports on remaining job posting time and CV access in less than 5 seconds, for up to 100 concurrent report requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time reporting, requiring timely responses for usability and decision-making.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must provide interactive and customizable reporting features for remaining job posting time and CV access, allowing users to easily explore and analyze the data within 10 minutes of initial interaction.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to support user engagement and exploration, necessitating intuitive and interactive reporting features.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for easy modification and updates to reporting features and data sources for remaining job posting time and CV access, with a maximum of 2 hours of development time for 90% of potential changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves reportable information, which may require frequent updates and changes, necessitating modular and maintainable system design.
